title: The ALMA-PILS survey: First detection of nitrous acid (HONO) in the interstellar medium
question: Is nitrous acid (HONO) present in the ISM towards IRAS16293 B, what are its abundance and excitation, and can a gas-grain chemical model reproduce it along with other nitrogen oxides?

data.bands: Band 7 (PILS); band 3 and band 6 PILS data also searched

what.value: Column densities of NO, N2O, NH2OH towards IRAS16293 B

evidence.quote: The trans/cis energy difference (130.2 cm$^{-1}$) is from (cite: Varma1976).
we have used the physical structure derived from a 1D radiative hydrodynamical model (cite: 2008ApJ...674..984A)

recipe.goal: Identify HONO lines and check blending
recipe.method: Compare candidate lines with template of previously detected species in PILS spectra, using JPL and CDMS spectroscopy

recipe.goal: Derive HONO column density and Tex
recipe.method: LTE synthetic spectrum chi2 grid fit
key_parameters: Tex grid 50–300 K step 25 K; N grid 5e14–3e15 cm-2 step 1e14
assumptions: source size 0.5", VLSR 2.5 km/s, background temperature 21 K

recipe.goal: Upper limits for HNO, NO+, NO2, HNO3
recipe.method: 3sigma upper limits at Tex=100 K from line-free regions/brightest predicted lines
Nautilus gas-grain model: cold core phase 1e6 yr then collapse from 1D radiative hydro model, parcel arriving at 62.4 au; compare abundance ratios
key_parameters: cold phase: T=10 K, nH=1e4 cm-3, Av=15, zeta=1.3e-17 s-1

evidence.quote: The best-fit model is obtained for an excitation temperature of 100 K and a column density of 9 $\times$ 10$^{14}$ cm$^{-2}$.

answer_key.quantity: HONO column density at fixed Tex=300 K

evidence.quote: the best-fit column density is 1.4 $\times$ 10$^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$

evidence.loc: Upper limit determination of HNO, NO+, NO2, and HNO3

not_stated_but_needed: Exact spectral line-free/continuum handling and continuum subtraction (in PILS paper)
Exact pixel/beam extraction method of spectra
Full chemical network (only HONO reactions in Table C.1)
Initial elemental abundances and grain parameters for Nautilus
Fit weighting/noise values used in chi2
Line widths fit details for HONO beyond FWHM 1 km/s
missing_for_reproduction: Full chemical network and Nautilus inputs
PILS calibrated cubes processing details (in Jørgensen 2016)
score_reason: Public data and clear LTE grid, but the chemical model network is not fully given and imaging is inherited from PILS.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, explicit LTE grid, numeric results (N, Tex).
